text_block_list.text:
Phew...
Seems I was just a bit lacking in strength~

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"Before the next race,
I simply must do something about this 'slight' issue."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I believe I was able to give everything
my current self has to offer in this race.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
However—what I desire lies far higher.
As I am now, I am nowhere near close.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
To close that "little bit" left this time,
I'll be counting on your continued guidance~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Let's make sure to firmly remember these feelings.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: "I'm sure these feelings will serve as encouragement for what's next."
